output.technical_predicate: The application form and the accepted /apply payload (including what is persisted or sent onward) must be limited to the applicant inputs necessary for the stated purposes: contact email (delivery), amount and term (requested offer), and income band (assessment). No field without a business purpose in this fixture (e.g., a hobby) may be collected, accepted, persisted, or forwarded.
applicability_facts: Scenario: loan application submitted with email for delivery, amount and term for the requested offer, income band for assessment; a hobby has no business purpose in this fixture.
Form fields rendered for customers: email, amount, term, income, plus the 'auto' route checkbox (views.py 0031-0032).
Server-side allowlist on the accepted payload: set(data) <= {email, amount, term, income, auto} (store.py 0067).
Persisted columns: cases(email, amount, term, income, route, ...) (store.py 0036-0038, 0077-0078); summary title uses amount and term (store.py 0079).

Onward disclosure: offer() returns email, amount, term (store.py 0112); portable() returns email, amount, income (store.py 0116); transfer stores that payload for the receiving controller (store.py 0203).
relevant_exceptions: No exception applies to permit a purposeless field such as a hobby; the fixture states it has no business purpose.
The 'auto' checkbox is a processing-route choice tied to the automatic-decision option described in the notice, not an extra applicant attribute; it is not a hobby-type field.
Officer-side 'verify'/'notify-release' band inputs (store.py 0158, 0180) are staff confirmations of the same income band, not additional applicant collection.
required_controls: Form renders only email, amount, term, income and the route checkbox (views.py 0031-0032).
Server rejects any unexpected field via the allowlist check (store.py 0067), so a 'hobby' key in the payload yields 'Unexpected application field.'
Persistence writes only email, amount, term, income, route, stage (store.py 0077-0078); no hobby column exists in the schema (store.py 0036-0038).
Onward payloads are restricted to email/amount/term (offer, store.py 0112) and email/amount/income (portable/transfer, store.py 0116, 0203).
Field-level validation bounds amount (100-100000), term (6/12/24/36), income in LIMITS, and email format (store.py 0060-0074).
assessment_limits: Assessment is limited to the supplied source text; no execution, runtime probing, or repository access was performed.
Only the named minimization behavior (form fields, accepted payload, persistence, onward sends) is assessed; other GDPR obligations are out of scope.
The 'auto' route field is treated as a processing choice, not an applicant attribute; whether it is 'necessary' is not decided here.
No conclusion is drawn about upstream or hidden implementation beyond the three supplied artifacts.
Compliance is not decided from the rule description alone; it rests on the cited source coordinates and the stipulated scenario facts.
